proposal.theorem_delta: Construct finiteMixture from constant-density kernels, prove one pointwise measure evaluation interface, prove normalized Markovness and preservation of an arbitrary common invariant μ, then test lazy heat-bath and finite powers via existing interfaces.

proof_route: Form the finite sum of Kernel.withDensity with constant NNReal-coerced density.
Prove measurable_const for the uncurry density, then use MeasureTheory.withDensity_const for pointwise evaluation.
Prove Markovness from component mass one and the fixed weight sum.
Evaluate bind on a measurable set, use finite-sum and constant-multiple lintegral linearity, then component invariance and weight normalization.
Test arbitrary μ, zero weights, and the identity/heatBathSnd mixture using invariant_pow.
